withdraw.carryEstimate: The strategy currently has a funding deficit. Your collateral claim is not reduced, but settlement may take longer while funding is recovered.
withdraw.ack: I understand my {{shareSymbol}} stays invested during the {{hours, number}}-hour cooldown. The withdrawal then settles to {{symbol}} as funds become available. My portion of unconverted yield may settle separately in HOLLAR, after costs and fees; the cooldown is not a settlement deadline.
withdraw.blocked.paused: The vault is paused. Withdrawal requests are temporarily unavailable.
strategy.apyEstimate: Indicative annual carry at current rates, after source and Main borrowing costs and harvest fees. Swap fees, slippage, ramp time and conversion delays are excluded. This is not realized crypto APY; only converted, funded earnings increase your crypto balance.
positions.earningsDescription: Converted earnings stay invested and keep compounding before you claim them. Claiming adds their vault shares to your position. Earnings awaiting conversion are an estimate, not a funded collateral balance.
deposit.executionDescription: Deposits use a fresh swap quote and share a trade limit with strategy reinvestment. If approval is needed, confirm it first, then review the deposit. Capacity and quotes can change before confirmation.
deposit.failed: The deposit could not complete. Check the current limits and retry for a fresh quote. A completed token approval remains available for your next attempt.
positions.readFailed: Some position or withdrawal data could not be refreshed. Amounts may be out of date. Try again after the connection recovers.
